tutorial.title: How does it work?
tutorial.subtitle: Three quick points to get started.

step1.title: What is it for?
step1.text: Some websites are stricter depending on the browser (Twitch is a good example). The extension sends a Chrome-like identity to selected pages, which can remove blocks or rendering issues.

step2.title: Twitch and Streamrunners pack
step2.text: This is optional: if you see issues on these sites (black screen, loading stuck), open Presets and enable the pack. You can also do it when opening the extension for the first time. On Streamrunners, the extension signals pack activation only when you open their site, to avoid unnecessary background work.

step3.title: Add a site to the list
step3.text: Go to the target website, open the extension, then click “Add current site”. Refresh the page (F5 or equivalent) so the change is applied.

card1.title: What is this project?
card1.text: My name is ManonOnAir. I built this extension so users are not penalized for their browser choice. It stays simple, free, and ad-free.

card2.title: Is privacy handled seriously?
card2.text: Yes. Settings and site list stay on your device. I collect no personal data through the extension and I cannot access your browsing activity.

step1.title: Choose your language
step1.text: You can change the language now or later from the interface.

step2.title: Your data
step2.text: Your site list and settings are stored locally in the browser (extension storage). Nothing is sent to our servers: we do not see your visits or what you do online.

step3.title: ManonOnAir
step3.text: This project is open source and built with ❤️ by ManonOnAir. You can support me on Patreon or access the source code on GitHub.

step4.title: Twitch / Streamrunners pack
step4.text: This pack helps reduce bugs on Twitch (player, black screen) and Streamrunners, especially with Brave.
step4.text_extra: It is optional: enable it only if needed. You can change it later in Presets. For Streamrunners, this setting is applied only when you open the site.

step5.title: Welcome to MUserAgentSwitcher
step5.pack_enabled: The Twitch / Streamrunners pack is enabled. You can disable or edit it in Presets.
step5.pack_skipped: No pack for now: it remains available in Presets if you need it later.
step5.joke: Enjoy browsing! On the web, pressing F5 is still the fastest “turn it off and on again”. Simple, but still effective. Your data does not travel around the world - it stays on your computer.
